overview_description.description: MellBell Electronics is a community-driven electronics company. And is going to lead the DIY, and open source hardware movements in the MENA region. It started Its first bet yet, a well placed belief on the world’s smallest Arduino-compatible board, PICO, which lets MellBell set a firm foot in the market. MellBell focuses on helping makers make, by providing a plethora of content that builds the necessary skills, whilst expanding their unique product family. With the vision of leaping from the physical board to the cloud.
